text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She shakes off the pack and crosses the finish line in first!
The winner is—...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Oh, how towering the wall of the Classic Triple Crown is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Even so... in that fleeting moment, Yaeno's fighting spirit soared to the heavens like a dancing flame.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Controlling that consciously is
truly worthy of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Still green!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ugh... ngh, uuu...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san... Chiyono O-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Tasting defeat and lamenting your frustration
is a privilege reserved only for those who fought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As I am now, I am not even permitted to grieve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"At the Japanese Derby, without fail.
I want to shine brightly on the turf too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No matter what price must be paid.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-dono, I am truly ashamed.
choice_data_list: There's no need for you to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However... even so!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How pathetic!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win...
I wanted to dedicate this victory to Grandpa...!
choice_data_list: Let's win the next Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I vowed to dedicate myself even further for that very purpose.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Next time...
Next time I'll win and prove it...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That the path I had walked was not a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Choosing races as a place
to channel and elevate that fighting spirit, too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That she had trained rigorously to master
and control her fiery passion through "Unity of Fire and Water."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll prove that I have grown by following the path Grandpa showed me!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: At the Japan Derby, without fail!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's earnest, gut-wrenching plea.
Fulfilling it is precisely a Trainer's duty.
choice_data_list: Yeah! I promise I'll guide you to victory!
Yeah! I promise to guide you to the end!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu!!
I shall devote myself with all my might!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her voice was choked with tears,
Yaeno Muteki declared it with conviction.
